# Discussion and conclusion {background-color="#491106ff"}

## Discussion and conclusion

:::: {.incremental style="font-size: 120%;"}

- Findings: meritocratic perceptions and endorsing privilege raise MJP; perceiving privilege lowers it [@castillo_perceptions_2025]
- Broad measurement of meritocratic beliefs reveals distinct paths: perception vs preference, merit vs privilege
- SEM (measurement error, latent paths) is a useful, transferable tool for other beliefs, criteria and domains
- Limits: cross-sectional, one country; next: conjoint experiments and cross-country analysis

::::
